Berliner Kältehilfe

Berlin, Germany
Checked 2026-08-14

Berliner Kältehilfe provides emergency overnight accommodation, warm meals, and medical help for homeless people in Berlin during the cold season. The service aims to prevent people without shelter from freezing to death.

  • Shelter
  • Food
  • Health
CostFree resource finder.

The service is free of charge for people who have no place of their own and cannot afford accommodation.

AccessOfficial online locator and app
Open listing
Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Berlin, Germany

Check before you go. The cold relief season lasts from October to April. Emergency overnight stays are generally open every evening during this period.

Service network

Warming Centers

Chicago, United States
Checked 2026-08-14

The Chicago Department of Family and Support Services activates its Community Service Centers and Senior Centers as warming centers during extreme cold weather. These locations provide safe refuge and relief for all residents when temperatures drop to 32 degrees or below.

  • Shelter
CostFree.

The warming centers are available at no cost to residents.

AccessWalk-in warming centers
Open listing
Hours, location & verification
Coverage
Citywide network of 6 Community Service Centers and 20 Senior Centers in Chicago, IL

Check before you go. Activated when temperatures are expected to be 32 degrees or below. Community Service Centers are open Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., and Senior Centers are open Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.
